messages:
maya: Heads-up: sampleapp produced duplicate side-effects when a 429 hit at the same time as token refresh. Repro steps in local node/sdk shim.
jordan: ugh. can you paste the smallest repro log?
maya: snippet:
```
POST /v1/generate id=req-77 Idempotency-Key=ik-77 -> 429
starting token refresh
POST /v1/generate id=req-77 Idempotency-Key= (new) -> 200  <-- duplicate write
```
eli: looks like the client regenerates the Idempotency-Key post-refresh. We must persist the header across refresh.
priya: Proposed fix: add client-side replay_guard middleware that stores (request_id -> timestamp + idempotency_key) for safe_replay_window_ms. Default params: safe_replay_window_ms=3000, base_backoff_ms=200, random_jitter_ms=150, max_backoff_ms=2500, max_retries=5. Backoff formula: sleep = min(max_backoff_ms, base_backoff_ms * 2^attempt + rand(0, random_jitter_ms)).
jordan: Agree. Also parity note: node/python/go SDKs should share these defaults. Add tests to sampleapp harness that simulate auth refresh + injected 429.
eli: For streaming endpoints: recommend resumable session token + per-message dedupe-id header (Dedup-Id) rather than a single Idempotency-Key for the whole stream.
maya: Docs snippet for quickstart: 
```
const key = reuseIdempotencyKey();
headers['Idempotency-Key'] = key;
await client.post('/generate', {prompt}, {headers});
```
priya: Ops: if server can emit Retry-After we should use it. @ops-robot can infra return Retry-After for token-rotation 429s?
ops-robot: ci alert: sampleapp-integration tests flaked (build 901). I'll add a metric to catch duplicate side-effects.
jordan: I'll create a deterministic integration test that forces a 429 during refresh and asserts a single side-effect. Will PR today.
priya: Roadmap: (1) jordan test PR -> (2) replay_guard middleware in SDK -> (3) sampleapp harness update -> (4) docs quickstart patch -> (5) release notes.
maya: Thanks team. Drop traces/logs here if you find other dupes. :thumbsup:
